name: Does marble tile need to be sealed before and after installation?

mainEntity.name: Does marble tile need to be sealed before and after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, sealing is a required preparation step for all natural marble tile installations. Because natural marble contains microscopic pores, applying a penetrating impregnating sealer before or immediately after placement protects the stone from absorbing colored grout pigments during the grouting phase. Once the install is finished and fully cured, an additional coat seals the surface against daily moisture and household oils. Homeowners should plan to reseal their marble tile surfaces every one to two years depending on wear and water exposure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. A penetrating sealer applied before grouting prevents grout pigment stains, and another coat after installation protects the stone against water and oils.
